name: hybrid-glitch-sound-design
style: Hybrid trailer sound-design underscore, 86 BPM, a soft steady clock-tick pulse holding the grid, no melody, no chords. Opens on a sudden bright digital flash: deep sub boom, reversed swell, cold metallic hit. Digital glitch stutters and bit-crushed dropouts as a signal tears apart. Then one long rising tension riser, filtered noise and pitch climbing together, peaking into a single heavy low impact with a sub drop and a long dark tail. Energy only in deep sub and airy high textures, empty midrange to leave room for narration. Serious, cold, unsettling, modern. Instrumental only, no vocals.
exclude: vocals, choir, humming, spoken word, melodic lead, chord progression, drum kit groove, swing, comedic, tempo change
